Informational website

This website describes music metadata, publishing administration, rights research, royalty recovery, DMCA enforcement, and related consulting services. Website content is general information and does not create a consultant-client, attorney-client, fiduciary, or other professional relationship.

Rights Gap Analysis

The free Rights Gap Analysis is a preliminary review based on the five song titles and information you provide, together with records reasonably available for review. It is not a complete catalog audit, legal opinion, ownership determination, or guarantee that royalties will be found or recovered.

You are responsible for providing accurate information and for having the right to share any song titles, catalog details, links, or documents you submit. Do not submit material that infringes another person’s rights.

Paid work begins only after the scope, deliverables, timing, fees, and any additional terms are agreed separately in writing. Scheduling a call or submitting a form does not obligate either party to enter an engagement.
